blocks.text: Shang Bauhinia Residences opened its Show Suite on September 8, 2026, giving Cebuanos a firsthand look at the units, materials, and finishes planned for the 52-storey residential tower rising along Gov. Cuenco Avenue corner Bauhinia Drive in Barangay Kasambagan. The opening marks a notable step for the local property market. Shang Bauhinia Residences is the first project by Shang Properties, Inc. built outside Metro Manila. It brings a new residential option to a part of Cebu City already surrounded by major commercial districts. Why the Show Suite matters for Cebu The tower sits about 0.3 kilometers from Cebu I.T.
